note: Campground and conference center on Lake Rd above the Lake Ontario shore at Appleton (Niagara Co), among the fruit farms east of Olcott; lakeview full-hookup sites along the bluff, larger 50-amp sites in a quieter area, and dry-camping spots. Google 4.5 over 113 reviews. --Claude
summary: Campspot confirms $42 dry RV site to $51-53 full hookup on October weeknights (Saturday $47-65), 50-amp full hookups, Campspot booking; NEW: 72-hour online booking cutoff, weeknight 2-night minimum on the lakeview hookup sites (booking note; dry sites take 1 night), season ends Oct 31 (opening not posted), pull-throughs, camp store. Base $42 is under the US$50 gate; working website + phone + engine (presence passes); nightly rate posted, no long-stay issue. Note: dropped the price, hookup and minimum restatements.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: the operator's RV page says the lakeview sites are 'Most ... currently located waters edge with panoramic views of Lake Ontario'; the entry is 'lakeview'.

Price: the base is the $42 dry-camping RV site, under US$50; every hookup site is $51-53 on weeknights ($63-65 on the Saturday probed), over US$50, and no gateway is within 40 km (nearest Niagara Falls 43 km). Family has not stayed here.
